subject: Inbound webinar invite: priority audience splits, draft copy, and RSVP cadence
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff — inbound webinar: audience split + two short subject line options

Hi team,

I sketched a quick plan for the inbound invite series for the March webinar on inference cost/perf tradeoffs. Goal: drive 600–800 registrations with a 35% live show rate for developer/engineering audience and 20% for platform/infra managers. High-level asks:

- Marissa: review the two copy paths (developer-first and platform-buyers) and pick primary subject lines.
- Ben: confirm target lists (we should prioritize recent trialers + infra-tagged leads) and suggest the initial audience split.
- I'll wire up the tracking link skeleton and RSVP reminder cadence.

Attached: invite_onepager_v1.pdf (one-pager we can use as social/share), audience-priority-list.xlsx (seeded targets), tracking-links-v3.csv (link skeleton we'll populate).

Quick copy options (short):
1) "Reduce inference cost by 3x — live demo + playbook"
2) "How top teams cut token spend without quality loss — live"

Cadence idea (initial thought):
- Day 0: Invite (primary subject)
- Day 4: Reminder with snippet from playbook + speaker quote
- Day 8: Last-chance + short TL;DR
- Day -1 (12 hrs): SMS/personal nudge for high-priority accounts (if we have direct numbers)

Audience split suggestion (seeded):
- 45% recent trial accounts (30d active)
- 25% platform/infra leads (tag: infra, architect)
- 20% developer opt-in list (newsletter clicks last 90d)
- 10% partner-sourced (co-marketing lists)

Please reply with edits inline — I'll consolidate and publish tracking links by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: invite_onepager_v1.pdf (PDF)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — inbound webinar: audience split + two short subject line options

Thanks Vivek — nice outline. Quick notes and edits below (keeps developer tone but shortens CTAs). I pasted a suggested first invite body and two longer CTAs for follow-ups. I also uploaded an updated tracking-links CSV to the Drive (folder in related_links).

Suggested Day 0 invite (dev-first):
Hi {first_name},
We’re running a 45-min session showing how teams reduce per-token cost without retraining: live demo, quantization patterns, and a ready-to-run batch strategy. Join engineers from top SaaS teams on Mar 28.
[CTA] Reserve your seat — limited spots

Short follow-up (Day 4):
Quick win: tune your batching and cache settings to cut 20–40% in token spend. See examples live.
[CTA] View example snippets + RSVP

Last chance (Day 8):
Seats almost full — last opportunity to join the live workshop. We’ll post the recording but space for Q&A is limited.
[CTA] Save my spot

Audience split edits: swap 20% partner-sourced -> 30% (we have a co-marketing with EdgeCloud) and reduce developer opt-in to 10% to avoid overmessaging. Updated audience-priority-list.xlsx attached.

I also propose removing the more sales-y subject line ("Reduce inference cost by 3x") — it reads like a promise and will likely trigger higher spam rates. Use the second option or a softer one: "Practical steps to cut inference spend — live demo"

Uploading the revised invite copy and a short checklist for deliverables to the Drive now.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: audience-priority-list.xlsx (Excel)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — inbound webinar: audience split + two short subject line options

Looping in a quick ops point — for the seeded lists I recommend the following order of activation to maximize RSVP quality:
1) Trialers last 30d (45%): prioritized, send personalized subject line with account-based snippet.
2) Infra/architect tags (25%): send at 10am local time for each region.
3) Partner co-marketing (30%): EdgeCloud to send to their list 24 hours after our Day 0 send (we can stagger to capture overflow).

On tracking: we need per-segment UTM values (utm_campaign=mar28_inbound; utm_medium=email; utm_source=segment_name). I updated tracking-links-v3.csv with UTM rows and a HubSpot workflow ID placeholder.

Also: EMEA timezone optimization — shift sends to avoid midnight local. If Marissa agrees on partner split, we should add an APAC pass with local send windows.

Ben
Ben Carter
Growth Marketing, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: tracking-links-v3.csv (CSV)]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@edgecloud.io
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized: send plan + action owners (publish by EOD)

Thanks both — merging notes. Final decisions for ops:

- Subject line: "Practical steps to cut inference spend — live demo" (Marissa final)
- Audience split: Trialers 45% / Infra 25% / Partner (EdgeCloud) 30%
- Regional passes: US base, EMEA adjusted send window, APAC soft pass (opt-in only)
- Cadence: Day 0 / Day 4 reminder / Day 8 last-chance / Day -1 nudge for high-priority accounts
- Tracking: Ben to publish finalized tracking CSV to Drive and add HubSpot workflow ID by 4pm PT
- Reminders: Marissa to draft Day 4 copy and speaker quote snippets; I will prepare the Day -1 high-priority SMS stub and a personalization checklist for account owners.

Action owners:
- Marissa: copy for Day 4 + approve subject by EOD (marissa.cole@redwood.ai)
- Ben: finalize UTM rows and insert HubSpot workflow ID (ben.carter@redwood.ai)
- Vivek: schedule send windows and create RSVP segments in HubSpot; coordinate EdgeCloud send (partners@edgecloud.io)

Links: Drive folder and HubSpot record in related_links. Please mark items done in the sheet so I can publish the send schedule.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
